prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was telling someone about that rail hop I did from Beijing down to Shanghai—super smooth ride, way less stressful than flying.
And on a totally different trip, I spent a few days in Nanjing—mostly just wandering around and eating everything in sight.
When I was in Shanghai, I remember chatting about what to see there—everyone had opinions, but the city basically sells itself.
That same Shanghai visit, my friends kept talking up the local shows too—like there was always something on at night.
For that Beijing-to-Shanghai run, the ticket was already set as train D321 on 2025-03-23, under Zhao Min, and it was Second Class—nothing fancy but totally fine.
My coworker also told me about their Nanjing stay: it was Sofitel Nanjing Galaxy, checking in 2025-04-25 for 4 nights, and the booking name was Aiden Miller.
Oh—and Emily Wang had already gotten her ticket to the Oriental Pearl Tower for 2025-03-16 in the afternoon, just 1 ticket, so she went up solo and sent pics.
